description:
Check whether a value is a standard CBV term for an EPCIS event field, before putting it
in a document. Returns VALID, or NOT STANDARD with the nearest standard term when the
value is a known near-miss.

Use this whenever you are not certain of a term. EPCIS 2.0 JSON requires the bare short
name (`shipping`), never the EPCIS 1.x URN (`urn:epcglobal:cbv:bizstep:shipping`) and
never the CBV URI (`https://ref.gs1.org/cbv/BizStep-shipping`) — all three are checked
here and only the first is accepted.

field.description: The event field: bizStep, disposition, bizTransactionType, sourceType/destinationType

value.description: The value you intend to use, e.g. "shipping"

name: validateCbvTerm
title: Validate a CBV term
